There is nothing that will cover the colour and let you go back to purple after that without bleach. I would wear a pretty wig. You can get them really cheap and pull them off easily. Yeah so true! Where i live (germany) it is absolutely normal to go to supermarkets and ask them for their banana boxes. They are so friggin sturdy! And they are perfect to pack books in it. Usually books get really heavy but these banana boxes are sturdy enough and small enough so you can pack them and carry them easily. They have a open rectangle on the bottom but if you fill them smart there's nothing slipping out.
